summary: Different login users, ports or connection types per host are easiest to set with inventory variables such as ansible_user, ansible_port and ansible_connection, or in group_vars.
questions: How do I use a different SSH port for one host?
Can each host have its own login user?
How do I set connection local for localhost in inventory?

answer_card.title: Per-host user, port and connection
answer_card.answer_md:
Set them in inventory:

```ini
[webservers]
asdf.example.com ansible_port=5000 ansible_user=alice
jkl.example.com  ansible_port=5001 ansible_user=bob

[testcluster]
localhost ansible_connection=local
```

Or put them in `group_vars/<group>` / `host_vars/<host>`.
